text: I've had the cough for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started recently when I try to exert myself. speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful. Since you have a productive cough but no fever or weight loss, do you notice wheezing or a "whooshing" sound in your chest when you listen closely? Also, does the shortness of breath improve when you sit up straight or lean forward?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with productive cough.
